_comment: Copy to bridge.json (never committed) and fill in. twitch: the channel's name is enough to read its chat; oauth_token and nick only for a chat closed to guests. youtube: api_key of your own Google Cloud project with YouTube Data API v3 on, and video_id of the live broadcast (the part after watch?v=). min_interval_seconds keeps the polls within the daily quota: each costs 5 of 10 000 units. game: where the game listens (reserve.json link).
